verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for an AI assistant and API service like Kimi, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or residency controls for either the assistant or the API platform. The project-level IP whitelist and budget controls are adjacent features, not data residency, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
